reason: Primary purpose is a DSH Web UI utility for visually organizing and working across multiple conversations: the plugin presents sessions as canvas cards, supports local layout arrangement, and lets users continue dialogue, call commands, and create summary sessions from that same view.

summaries.zh: 该插件面向 DSH Web 提供会话画布工作区，可将多个会话汇总为可视化卡片，支持拖拽整理并在卡片内继续与模型交互。
summaries.en: This DSH Web plugin provides a session-canvas workspace that aggregates multiple chats into visual cards, allowing users to arrange them and continue interacting with model sessions directly from the canvas.

capabilities: Display and arrange multiple DSH sessions as draggable, resizable cards on a canvas
Send follow-up messages to selected sessions from card interfaces
Link sessions and inject context/content between sessions
Create new sessions and invoke slash commands/skills from the canvas
Persist canvas layout state per workspace in browser localStorage
Archive/remove sessions from the canvas with effects in DSH session state

reasons.code: README describes a multi-session canvas with cards that can be dragged, scaled, connected, and organized on the workspace.
README states users can send messages in-card and invoke slash commands/skills (including / and Enter execution), enabling active chat/task actions from the plugin UI.
README notes session context injection between cards and creation of summary sessions, indicating cross-session operation beyond read-only display.
README and package metadata identify this as a DSH Web plugin integrated via DSH bundle/patch wiring, so it executes in the host assistant environment.
README explains canvas layout is stored in browser localStorage, which affects persistence and local state behavior.
